title: MCP + LSP Runtime
goal: Integrar MCP e LSP como runtimes governados por capabilities, permissões, timeouts e evidência.
definition_of_done: Implementação integrada ao Event Bus e Evidence Ledger
Testes unitários e integração sem mocks para os caminhos obrigatórios
Documentação, observabilidade, segurança e rollback definidos
Gate E2E obrigatório antes de marcar done
notes: Planejado para a sequência pós-F16; não considerar implementado até os gates reais passarem.
JSON-RPC MCP/LSP framing source implemented; real server E2E pending.
v0.16 adds typed JSON-RPC errors/ids, legacy + modern MCP version model, flexible Content-Length framing and degraded reports.
Claw Code MIT upstream is integrated by compatibility code + private external CLI bridge; full vendor checkout is fetched only on private networked build hosts.
Remote Streamable HTTP/SSE/WebSocket transports are not release-ready until real E2E gates pass.
v0.64 adds managed real child-process sessions for MCP/LSP stdio and Streamable HTTP request transport.
Host-level real-process fixture smoke: 7/7 PASS; Rust cargo/native independent-server E2E remains a release gate.
WebSocket is treated as a non-standard PhxClaw extension; standard remote MCP release path is Streamable HTTP.
